titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Egyptian Envoy's Report (ch. 59)
about: Solomon's messenger, an Egyptian governor sent by Pharaoh, reports that the Ethiopians passed through Egypt with music and chariots, that the Egyptian gods fell and were broken as they entered, and that the Egyptian priests blame the Ark of the God of Israel for it. He reproaches Solomon for giving the Ark away, and Solomon answers evasively.

sentences.t: ፶፱ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሐተቶ ፡ ለግብጻዊ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ፈርዖን ።
sentences.i: Chapter 59. The questioning of the Egyptian, Pharaoh's servant.
sentences.n: Chapter heading; ፶፱ is the numeral 59. ኀበ at the start is the least clear word (?): possibly 'concerning/where', or an error for በእንተ as in other headings; I read the heading as a title for the scene. ሐተቶ looks like a verbal noun of ሐተተ 'to question, examine' (the form is uncertain (?)). ለግብጻዊ: ለ- marks the object or 'of' the questioned person; ግብጻዊ is 'Egyptian' (ግብጽ Egypt + -ዊ adjectival ending). ገብረ ፈርዖን is a construct chain: ገብር 'servant' becomes ገብረ before the dependent noun.

sentences.t: ወኀለፈ ፡ እምህየ ፡ ወረከበ ፡ ፩ ፡ መኰንነ ፡ እመኳንንተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ዘንጉሥ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ዘለአኮ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አምኃ ፡ ወምሉእ ፡ ንዋይ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ወበጽሐ ፡ ወሰገደ ፡ ለንጉሥ ።
sentences.l: And-he-passed from-there and-found one governor-of from-governors-of Egypt, of-king Pharaoh, whom-he-sent to-him with gifts and-full goods with-him, and-arrived and-bowed to-king.
sentences.i: He went on from there and found one governor, one of the governors of Egypt who belonged to King Pharaoh, whom Pharaoh had sent to him with gifts and goods of every kind; he arrived and bowed down before the king.
sentences.n: Subject of ወኀለፈ and ወረከበ is not named in the packet: 'he', presumably the man sent to look for the Ethiopians (?) (the previous part ends 'We saw nothing'). ወ- 'and' on each verb (ወኀለፈ, ወረከበ, ወበጽሐ, ወሰገደ) strings simple perfects. እም- in እምህየ and እመኳንንተ is 'from', and with the plural here partitive 'one of the governors'. መኰንነ is the object form of መኰንን 'governor'; እመኳንንተ is a broken plural. ዘንጉሥ ፈርዖን: ዘ- 'of/who belongs to'. ዘለአኮ: ዘ- relative 'whom' + ለአኮ 'he sent him' (ለአከ, with 3ms object suffix -ኦ). ምሉእ ንዋይ: 'full of goods' i.e. goods of every kind (?). ሰገደ 'to bow down, prostrate'; ለንጉሥ 'before the king'.

sentences.t: ወአፍጠኖ ፡ ሐቲተ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ የሀብ ፡ አምኃሁ ፡ ወመልእክቶ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ቦኑ ፡ ዘርኢከ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይግዕዙ ፡ እምህየ ።
sentences.l: And-hastened him to-question-him Solomon the-king before he-give his-gifts and-his-message, and-said-to-him: Is-there that-you-saw people-of Ethiopia while they-travel from-there?
sentences.i: King Solomon hurried to question him before he could hand over his gifts and his message, and said to him, 'Did you happen to see any Ethiopians travelling away from there?'
sentences.n: ወአፍጠኖ ሐቲተ: አፍጠነ is the causative (A-stem) of ፈጠነ 'be quick', so 'he made haste'; the ሐቲተ is the infinitive 'to question'. The -ኖ suffix is odd (?): I take it as a loose 'on his part'/object marker, not 'hurried him'. ዘእንበለ 'before / without' takes the subjunctive የሀብ 'he give' (ወሀበ 'to give'); the suffixes in አምኃሁ ('his gifts') and መልእክቶ ('his message') are 3ms. ወይቤሎ: ይቤ 'he said' + ሎ 'to him' (the common formula). ቦኑ: ቦ 'there is' + the question particle -ኑ: 'is it that?'. ዘርኢከ 'that you saw' (ርእየ). ሰብአ ኢትዮጵያ: construct, 'people-of Ethiopia'. እንዘ ይግዕዙ: እንዘ + imperfect = 'while they were travelling' (ግዕዘ 'to go, journey, migrate'); the same root gives the language-name Geʿez.

sentences.t: ወአውሥአ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ መልአከ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ሕያው ፡ አንተ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: And-answered and-said-to-him the-messenger-of Pharaoh to-the-king: Alive you, king, for-ever;
sentences.i: Pharaoh's messenger answered him and said to the king, 'May you live, O king, forever.'
sentences.n: አውሥአ 'he answered' with ወይቤሎ 'and said to him' is a standard speech opening. መልአከ ፈርዖን: construct 'messenger-of Pharaoh', here subject. ሕያው አንተ 'alive (are) you', a verbless salutation; ንጉሥ is a vocative. ለዓለም 'for ever' (ዓለም 'world, age', ለ- 'to/for').

sentences.t: ለአከኒ ፡ እግዚእየ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ እምእስክንድርያ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወነዋ ፡ ኣየድዐከ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ መጻእኩ ፤
sentences.l: He-sent-me my-lord king Pharaoh from-Alexandria to-you, and-behold I-will-inform-you how I-came;
sentences.i: 'My lord King Pharaoh sent me to you from Alexandria, and now I will tell you how I came here.
sentences.n: ለአከኒ: ለአከ 'he sent' + -ኒ 'me' (1cs object suffix; do not confuse with the particle -ኒ 'also'). እግዚእየ 'my lord' (እግዚእ + -የ). ኀቤከ 'to you' (ኀበ + -ከ 'you'). ወነዋ 'and behold'. ኣየድዐከ is an uncertain form (?): I read it as the 1cs imperfect of a causative with -ከ 'you', 'I will make known to you'; the root is not clear to me and this is flagged for the glosser. ዘከመ 'how, that'. መጻእኩ 'I came' (መጽአ; 1cs perfect in -ኩ).

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ መጻእኩ ፡ እምእስክንድርያ ፡ ቦእኩ ፡ ቃህራ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገሩ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ወበብጽሐትየ ፡ በጽሑ ፡ ህየ ፡ እሉ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ዘትብል ፤
sentences.l: And-when I-came from-Alexandria I-entered Qahra into his-city, of-the-king; and-at-my-arrival arrived there these people-of Ethiopia whom-you-speak-of;
sentences.i: 'When I came from Alexandria I entered Cairo, the king's city. As I arrived, those Ethiopians you ask about arrived there as well;
sentences.n: ሶበ 'when' with the perfect. ቃህራ is Cairo (Arabic al-Qāhira); it is the object of ቦእኩ 'I entered' (በአ). ውስተ ሀገሩ ለንጉሥ: 'into his city, of the king', the anticipatory-suffix way of expressing a possessor (-ሁ then ለ + possessor) used throughout this chapter. ወበብጽሐትየ: በ- 'at' + ብጽሐት 'arrival' (noun of በጽሐ) + -የ 'my'. በጽሑ 'they arrived' (3mp perfect). እሉ 'these'. ዘትብል 'of whom you say': ዘ- + ትብል 'you say' (2ms imperfect of ቤለ), the king having asked about them.

sentences.t: በጽሑ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀለፈት ፡ ሠሉስ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ተከዚ ፡ ፈለገ ፡ ምስር ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይነፍሑ ፡ በዕንዚራት ፡ ወይረውጹ ፡ በሰረገላት ፡ ከመ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ሰማያዊያን ፤
sentences.l: They-arrived, which passed Tuesday, into Takazi river-of Egypt, while they-blow with-horns and-run in-chariots like host-of heavenly-ones;
sentences.i: they arrived last Tuesday at the Takazi, the river of Egypt, blowing horns and racing in chariots like a heavenly host;
sentences.n: እንተ ኀለፈት ሠሉስ: 'the Tuesday that passed', that is 'last Tuesday' (?); ሠሉስ means 'third' and in the week 'Tuesday', so 'three days ago' is the alternative (?). ተከዚ is in Ethiopia the name of a river (Tekezé); here it is called the river of Egypt, presumably the Nile (?). ፈለገ ምስር: construct, 'river-of Egypt' (ምስር is another word for Egypt). እንዘ ይነፍሑ: 'while they blow' (ነፍሐ 'to blow'); ዕንዚራት 'horns/pipes' (?), plural of an instrument noun. በ- 'with, in'. ይረውጹ 'they run' (ሮጸ). ሰረገላት 'chariots'. ከመ ኀይለ ሰማያዊያን: ኀይል 'power, army, host' in construct; ሰማያዊያን 'heavenly ones' (ሰማይ + -ዊ + plural -ያን).

sentences.t: ወእለ ፡ ርእይዎሙ ፡ ይቤልዎሙ ፡ እሉሰ ፡ እንዘ ፡ መሬታዊያን ፡ ኮኑ ፡ ሰማያዊያን ፡ መኑኬ ፡ ይጠብብ ፡ እምሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወውእቱኒ ፡ ኢሖረ ፡ በሰረገላ ፡ ነፉስ ፡ ከመዝ ፤
sentences.l: And-those-who saw-them said-to-them: These, while earthly, have-become heavenly; who is-wise more-than Solomon king-of Judah, and-he too did-not-go in-chariot-of wind like-this;
sentences.i: Those who saw them said, 'These men are of the earth, yet they have become heavenly. Who is wiser than Solomon, king of Judah? Even he never travelled in a wind-borne chariot like this.'
sentences.n: ወእለ ርእይዎሙ: እለ is the plural relative 'those who' + ርእይዎሙ 'they saw them' (ርእየ + -ሙ). ይቤልዎሙ: 'they said to them', who the addressees are is not stated (?). እሉሰ: -ሰ marks contrast, 'as for these'. እንዘ here concessive ('although') with a verbless clause; መሬታዊያን 'earthly ones' (መሬት 'earth'). ኮኑ 'they became' (ኮነ). መኑኬ: 'who?' + emphatic -ኬ. ይጠብብ እም-: comparative 'is wiser than' (ጠበበ). ንጉሠ ይሁዳ: construct. ወውእቱኒ ኢሖረ 'and he too did not go' (ሖረ, ኢ- negation). ነፉስ 'wind' (?) is not a form I can place; it may be a misspelling for ነፋስ or an adjective 'blown'; flagged. ከመዝ 'like this'.

sentences.t: ወእለ ፡ ሀለዉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወማኅፈድ ፡ ስምዐ ፡ ኮኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ቦኡ ፡ እሉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወድቁ ፡ ወተሰብሩ ፡ አማልክቲነ ፡ ወአማልክተ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወማኅፈደ ፡ ጣዖታትኒ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ተቀጥቀጡ ፤
sentences.l: And-those-who were in-cities and-fortress-of witness became that when entered these into land-of Egypt fell and-were-broken our-gods and-gods-of the-king, and-fortress-of idols too likewise were-crushed;
sentences.i: Those who were in the cities and the temple precincts became witnesses that, when these men came into the land of Egypt, our gods fell and were smashed, and the gods of the king too; and the shrines of the idols were likewise crushed.
sentences.n: ወእለ ሀለዉ 'and those who were' (ሀለወ 'to be, exist'). ማኅፈድ: 'tower, fortress', and from there 'temple precinct' (?); the same word recurs in construct as ማኅፈደ ጣዖታት. ስምዐ ኮኑ: ስምዕ 'witness' in the object form, as predicate of ኮኑ 'they became'. ከመ ሶበ ቦኡ 'that when they entered' (ቦኡ, from በአ, is 3mp). ወድቁ 'they fell' (ወድቀ) and ተሰብሩ is the passive/reflexive T-stem of ሰብረ 'to break': 'were broken'; the subject is አማልክቲነ 'our gods' (አማልክት plural of አምላክ + -ነ 'our'). The ኒ in ጣዖታትኒ is 'also, too'. ተቀጥቀጡ is a quadriliteral T-stem, 'were crushed'; the plural verb shows the subject is read as ጣዖታት 'idols', although ማኅፈደ is singular (?). ከማሁ 'likewise'.

sentences.t: ወሐተቱ ፡ ገነውተ ፡ አማልክት ፡ ማርያነ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘወድቁ ፡ አማልክቲነ ፡ ወይቤሉነ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እንተ ፡ ወረደት ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ሀለወት ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ወትነብር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገሮሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: And-questioned the-servants-of gods, ማርያን-of Egypt, concerning that fell our-gods, and-said-to-us: The-ark-of God-of Israel, which came-down from-heaven, is with-them and-dwells in-their-land for-ever;
sentences.i: The servants of the gods, the Egyptian elders (?), asked why our gods had fallen, and told us, 'The Ark of the God of Israel, which came down from heaven, is with them and stays in their country forever.
sentences.n: ገነውተ አማልክት: construct, 'servants-of gods' (ገነወ 'to serve'; ገነውት is probably the plural, so priests/attendants (?)). ማርያነ ግብጽ is uncertain (?): ማርያን may be a plural of መሪ 'leader, guide', so 'leaders of Egypt', or it may be a name for a class of diviners or magicians; the packet gives no way to decide. በእንተ ዘወድቁ 'about that they fell' (ዘ- + perfect = a noun clause 'the fall'). ወይቤሉነ: ይቤሉ 'they said' + ነ 'to us'. ታቦተ አምላከ እስራኤል: a double construct 'the Ark-of the God-of Israel'; ታቦት, the Ark of the covenant, is the theological centre of the book; 'which came down from heaven' reflects the tradition that the Ark's tablets were given from heaven (Exodus 25). እንተ ወረደት: fem relative + 'she descended'; the Ark is grammatically feminine, hence ሀለወት 'she is' and ትነብር 'she dwells' (ነበረ). ምስሌሆሙ 'with them', ሀገሮሙ 'their country'. እስከ ለዓለም 'for ever'.

sentences.t: ወበእንተዝኬ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ትበውእ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ተቀጥቀጡ ፡ አማልክቲነ ፤
sentences.l: And-therefore when she-enters land-of Egypt were-crushed our-gods;
sentences.i: That is why our gods were crushed when it entered the land of Egypt.
sentences.n: ወበእንተዝኬ: በእንተ + ዝ 'this' + -ኬ emphatic: 'and for this reason'. ሶበ ትበውእ: ትበውእ is 3fs imperfect (the Ark), 'when she enters'; the tense mixing (imperfect after ሶበ, then the perfect ተቀጥቀጡ) is idiomatic 'whenever / once she entered'. ብሔረ ግብጽ: construct 'land-of Egypt'.

sentences.t: ወአንተሰ ፡ ኦንጉሥ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘይመስላ ፡ ለጥበብከ ፡ እምታሕተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወለምንት ፡ ወሀብከ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ዘአንጽሑ ፡ ለከ ፡ አበዊከ ፤
sentences.l: And-you, O-king, there-is-not what resembles-it to-your-wisdom from-under heaven; and-why gave-you ark-of his-law, of-God your-God, which-sanctified-it for-you your-fathers;
sentences.i: 'And you, O king, have no equal in wisdom under heaven. Why then did you give away the Ark of the law of the Lord your God, which your fathers made holy for you?
sentences.n: ወአንተሰ: contrastive -ሰ, 'but as for you'. አልቦ ዘይመስላ ለጥበብከ: አልቦ 'there is not'; ዘይመስላ 'who resembles it' with the object suffix -ላ referring to ጥበብ 'wisdom' (fem?) and ለ- resuming it: 'nobody resembles your wisdom'. እምታሕተ ሰማይ 'from under heaven' = anywhere. ወለምንት 'and why?' (ለ- + ምንት 'what'). ወሀብከ 'you gave' (ወሀበ). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር: the possessor of the construct ታቦተ ሕጉ 'ark-of his law' is anticipated by -ሁ, then named with ለ- (the same device as ሀገሩ ለንጉሥ). ዘአንጽሑ: ዘ- 'which' + አንጽሐ, the causative (A-stem) of ጸሐየ/ጻሕ-type root meaning 'be pure', 'he purified' (?) i.e. sanctified with -ሁ 'it'; አበዊከ 'your fathers', the subject placed last.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ንሰምዕ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ታድኅነክሙ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ፀርክሙ ፡ ወመንፈሰ ፡ ትንቢትኒ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ይትናገረክሙ ፡ ወአምላከ ፡ ሰማይኒአ ፡ የኀድር ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ በመንፈሱ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ወትሰመዩ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: For we-hear that she will-save-you from-hand-of your-enemy, and-spirit-of prophecy too in-her speaks-to-you, and-God-of heaven too dwells within-her by-his spirit holy, and-you-are-called people-of his-house, of God;
sentences.i: For we hear that she saves you from the hand of your enemy, that the spirit of prophecy speaks to you through her, that the God of heaven dwells within her by his Holy Spirit, and that you are called the people of God's house.
sentences.n: እስመ 'for, because'. ንሰምዕ 'we hear' (ሰምዐ, 1cp imperfect). ከመ 'that' introduces what is heard; ይእቲ 'she' (the Ark). ታድኅነክሙ: ታድኅን is the causative (A-stem) of ድኅነ 'be safe', so 'saves'; -ክሙ 'you' (plural: the Israelites). እምእደ ፀርክሙ 'from the hand-of your enemy' (እድ 'hand' in construct). መንፈሰ ትንቢት 'spirit of prophecy'. ባቲ 'in/through her'. ይትናገረክሙ 'speaks to you': ተናገረ is the reciprocal T-stem of ነገረ. ሰማይኒአ: the ending -ኒአ is unclear (?), perhaps -ኒ 'too' with a stray አ. የኀድር 'dwells' (ኀደረ), ውስቴታ 'within her', በመንፈሱ ቅዱስ 'by his holy spirit' (a Christian reading; the adjective after the suffixed noun). ትሰመዩ: passive T-stem of ሰምየ 'to name': 'you are called'. ሰብአ ቤቱ ለእግዚኣብሔር: 'people-of his house, of God' (anticipatory suffix again); cf. Ephesians 2:19 'members of the household of God' (?).

sentences.i: Why have you given your glory to a stranger?'
sentences.n: ወለምንት ዘወሀብክሙ: ዘ- here is the relative used after 'why' to give 'why is it that you gave'; the verb is plural -ክሙ though it addresses Solomon, so the speaker means Solomon with Israel (?). ክብርክሙ 'your glory/honour': the Ark is called the glory of Israel, which is the book's own title word (ክብር, as in ክብረ ነገሥት). ለባዕድ 'to a stranger, a foreigner' (ባዕድ 'other').

sentences.t: አውሥአ ፡ በጥበብ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወይቤ ፡ በአይቴ ፡ ይክል ፡ ነሢኦታ ፡ ለእግዝእትነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሀለወት ፡ ኀቤነ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: Answered in-wisdom Solomon and-said: By-where can taking-her, our-lady, since she-is with-us?
sentences.i: Solomon answered with wisdom and said, 'How could anyone take our Lady away, when she is here with us?'
sentences.n: አውሥአ በጥበብ ሰሎሞን: Solomon is the subject, placed after the adverbial 'with wisdom'. ወይቤ 'and he said'. በአይቴ ይክል ነሢኦታ: በአይቴ 'where? by what way?' (አይቴ 'where'); ይክል 'he is able' (ክህለ); ነሢኦታ 'to take her' is the infinitive ነሢአ with the suffix -ታ 'her'; I read the sentence as 'how could one...' with no stated subject (?). ለእግዝእትነ: እግዝእት is the feminine of እግዚእ, 'lady' + -ነ 'our'; ለ- marks the object, 'our Lady' being a title for the Ark (and for Zion). እስመ ሀለወት ኀቤነ: 'since she is with us' (ኀቤነ from ኀበ + ነ). Solomon is being evasive here: he is neither admitting nor denying that the Ark has gone. The final ፨ ፨ closes the part.
